./docs/codex/ADHD_COGNITIVE_LOAD_UI_LAW.md:18:The law is not a medical claim. It is a product-quality and accessibility law for low cognitive load, calm prioritization, and progressive disclosure.

./docs/codex/ADHD_COGNITIVE_LOAD_UI_LAW.md:27:  - current UI firewall treats ugly UI, unreadable dock, clipped text, weak accessibility semantics, generic dashboard/card/list/form anatomy, and false Green as blockers.
